subject: general
question: With how many countries does India share its land boundaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** borders **seven nations**:

 
 
• **Bangladesh **to the east,** Bhutan and Nepal **to the north, **China, Myanmar** to the far east, and **Afghanistan and Pakistan** to the west.
 
 
 
• Two nations with water borders are the **Maldives** (from the south-west) and **Sri Lanka (**from the southeast). 
 
• The border with China is the longest land border in the world, spanning over 3,488 km.
 
• The border with Pakistan is also a sensitive area due to ongoing conflicts and disputes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** McMahon Line **was drawn in **1914** by **Sir Henry McMahon **and separates** China and India.**
 
• The **Radcliffe Line** is the boundary that separates** India and Pakistan.**
 
• **Sir Cyril Radcliffe** drew it in order to divide the two countries.
 
• The **India-Myanmar International Border **is the name given to the boundary separating India and Myanmar. 
 
• India also shares maritime boundaries with **Sri Lanka, Maldives, Indonesia, and Thailand.**
